name: wise-hirehop-proposal-platform
purpose: Wise internal HireHop enhancement package for proposal authoring, staging kit design, document preview, native item workflow helpers, proposal-page visibility, capacity tracking, project journey visibility, and QTC renderer alignment.

activeScripts.role: Tiny route-aware loader that defers page-specific Wise HireHop modules until their matching HireHop page, tab set, supplying list, project journey, or autopull dialog exists.

lazyScripts.role: Shared HireHop selectors, endpoint paths, depot rules, retry timings, search helpers, and tree item prefixes consumed by the section builder and capacity tracker.

Document preview panel used by power users on the supplying list. It opens docked by default after the toolbar entry point mounts, remains user-closable, and does not reopen automatically after the user closes it during that page session. Directly below the native buttons and above the list, a compact Commercial adjustments reminder and Job Performance strip reuse the live Job Track render to show the three job inputs plus final post-assumption Revenue, COS, GP£ and GP%. The solid-colour performance totaliser fills from 0% to the required 45% GP target and uses the current overall-GP heat colour: an accelerated below-target gradient to dark blue at 0%, green at 45%, dark green at 65%, amber at 75%, red at 90%, and deep red at 100%. The misleading native Replacement cost/Weight/Volume/Discount-Markup/Quoted net total footer is hidden presentation-only.
Small native-popup helper for repetitive line item selection actions across all depots.
Shared WisePageMeta and editor/template identifier contract consumed by the section builder and aligned to the QTC renderer.
Shared proposal page/layout catalogue consumed by the section builder.
Main proposal page editor and HireHop authoring layer. Retained but currently skipped by 0-loader.js; set its loader entry to enabled: true when it is needed again.

Full-page Wise capacity timeline, with a home-page entry button visible across all depots, using project-level custom fields, date-range filtering, Wise status controls, and sanitized absence overlay support.

Simple metric/imperial staging designer that caches live HireHop hire stock plus imperial sales consumables, adds the required small/medium/large staging box by deck count, limits carpet/fascia colour choices to exact live stock colours with a custom colour fallback, imports stage rows under a generated heading that includes 3/4 sided fascia, and keeps carpet to one combined stage-top/tread row.

Project and job page UI polish that hides Billing and Purchase orders tabs for non-admin users across all depots, keeps them visible for admin users, and adds a native Checklist tab panel with placeholder project/job checklist fields using native tab activation where available.

Project details page quality-of-life helper across all depots that keeps the jobs list reachable, adds a compact project-info toggle above the jobs grid, and hides secondary project-level timing fields so project dates read as the Wise event wrapper.

Project page Journey tab that visualises the Wise Event Wrapper from Start Date Time and Project End Date Time, operational milestones, critical path, readiness score, department readiness, and issues/exceptions with mock data plus live-data mapping hooks, using native tab activation where available.

Proposal Creation depot only (gated on the logged-in user's active depot via window.user, not the shared 5-hirehop.js DOM-scan helper, which was confirmed unreliable on this page): groups the native #proj_info project details fields into 5 white rounded 'card' sections (Wise Project Details, Project Ownership, Operational Timings, Working Links, System Details), reorders them so Salesforce/Wise info leads and native HireHop record fields (System Details, compact/collapsible via a Show more toggle) take a back seat, and gives every card an accent-coloured left rail plus icon badge so the live project/stage colour reads clearly. Wise Project Details renders as 3 equal columns and gets a coloured Status pill using a fixed stage palette (purple=quote, yellow=very likely, orange=hold, green=confirmed, grey=closed/lost/cancelled, blue=completed/invoiced). Accent colour is read directly from #proj_info's own inline background-color (the live project colour). Native layout structure and save behaviour fully unaffected — fields are reparented, never cloned/removed.

Proposal Creation depot only: replaces native Section:/Dept: supplying-list folder icons with distinct landscape page thumbnails—Section shows a hero image with a centred title, while Dept shows a half-image/half-table layout. Their // disabled forms keep the matching layout but add a muted slash. The exact Technical Summary support heading gets a separate eye-and-revenue medallion for its client-visible line items. Heading data and every unmatched native tree icon remain untouched.

referenceFiles.role: Copy of the renderer already deployed in HireHop; useful locally for alignment checks.
